observed_structure: The function derives an unindexed destination-slice base from gid.x, update shape, output strides, and output rank when the update slice has more than one element.
Each thread visits up to NWORK index positions while ind_idx remains below idx_size.
For each selected axis, a row-contiguous path uses ind_idx directly while the general path uses elem_to_loc over runtime index shape and stride metadata.
The function passes the loaded index value and out_shape[axis] to offset_neg_idx, multiplies the returned value by out_strides[axis], and adds it to the destination offset.
The update element uses a separate linear or elem_to_loc address before the function terminates in op.atomic_update.
variant_notes: NWORK is a template specialization, and ind_idx < idx_size bounds the work iteration rather than validating a loaded index value.
The update layout and terminal op.atomic_update call are scatter-specific; overwrite, reduction, conflict, ordering, and determinism semantics remain outside this observation.
The cited span contains no explicit upper- or lower-bound branch for the loaded index value after offset_neg_idx and therefore establishes no in-bounds or memory-safety result.
